data.name: Hotel Diego de Almagro Temuco
data.description:
Off the bustling Avenida Caupolicán thoroughfare, this low-key hotel in the city center is a 13-minute walk from Temuco railway station, and 3 km from soccer matches at Estadio Municipal Bicentenario Germán Becker Baechler.
Warmly decorated rooms feature free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, plus minifridges and sitting areas. Room service is available.
A complimentary breakfast buffet is served in a relaxed restaurant. Other amenities include an indoor heated pool, a sauna and a fitness room. There's also a simple lobby lounge. Covered parking is available.
